reproducibility: Bit-for-bit reproducible from source: the same CI run built every image twice more from two clean checkouts in two different directories, with no shared cache, and got identical digests (job "Reproducible boot images"). image-builder removes the sources of non-determinism found in v0.8.1 — random GPT GUIDs, and the link time and CodeView GUID the linker stamps into the embedded UEFI loader. A Windows host builds different bytes, because Rust embeds the build host's source paths in panic locations; the published files are the Linux CI build.
notice: v0.8.1 remains available at /downloads/v0.8.1/ with its own SHA256SUMS.txt. V0.10 work (program arguments, filesystem space reclamation, kernel task-stack guard pages) is NOT in these images — it exists only on the v0.10/integration branch.
